description_en: Queries the details of a task
name: QueryJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The task details returned if the call was successful. See the following parameter descriptions for details
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的任务详情信息，请参见以下参数说明

JobDocument.description_en: The task execution rule file delivered to devices
JobDocument.description_zh: 下发给设备的任务执行规则文件

JobFile.description_en: The download information of the task file

FileUrl.description_en: The download URL of the task file. The URL is valid for 30 minutes
FileUrl.description_zh: 任务文件的下载地址，地址有效时间为30分钟

Sign.description_en: The signature. The signature parameter generated based on the corresponding signature method for the file uploaded by URL
Sign.description_zh: 签名，通过URL上传的文件，根据相应的签名方法生成的签名参数

SignMethod.description_en: The signature method. Valid values: MD5 and SHA256

JobId.description_en: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task
JobId.description_zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符

RolloutConfig.description_en: The job rollout rate configuration for the task
RolloutConfig.description_zh: 任务下作业推送速率配置

MaximumPerMinute.description_en: The number of jobs pushed per minute for the task
MaximumPerMinute.description_zh: 任务下每分钟作业推送数量

MessageQoS.description_en:
The message sending type. This parameter is included only for custom tasks and Pub batch message push tasks. Valid values:

QoS0: The message is sent at most once.
QoS1: The message is sent at least once. If a PUBACK message is not received for a QoS1 message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects
MessageQoS.description_zh:
发送消息类型，仅对自定义任务和Pub批量消息推送任务包含该参数。可取值：

QoS0，表示最多发送一次。
QoS1，表示最少发送一次。如果QoS1消息未接收到PUBACK消息，会在设备重连时，重新推送给设备

ScheduledTime.description_en: The scheduled time of the task, in milliseconds
ScheduledTime.description_zh: 任务调度时间的毫秒数

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

INITIALIZING: Initializing.
WAITING: Pending scheduling.
IN_PROGRESS: Running.
COMPLETED: Completed.
CANCELLING: Being canceled.
CANCELLED: Canceled.
REMOVING: Being deleted.
TIMED_OUT: Timed out
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值范围：

INITIALIZING：初始化。
WAITING：待调度。
IN_PROGRESS：执行中。
COMPLETED：已完成。
CANCELLING：取消中。
CANCELLED：已取消。
REMOVING：删除中。
TIMED_OUT：已超时

TargetConfig.description_en: The target device configuration of the device task
TargetConfig.description_zh: 设备任务的目标设备配置

TargetGroup.description_en: The identifier (GroupID) of the device group to which the target devices belong
TargetGroup.description_zh: 目标设备所属设备分组的标识符（GroupID）

TargetProduct.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the target devices belong

TargetType.description_en:
The configuration type of the target devices. Valid values:   
DEVICE_LIST: device list.
GROUP_ID: device group ID.
PRODUCT_KEY: product ProductKey
TargetType.description_zh:
目标设备的配置类型，取值：   
DEVICE_LIST：设备列表。
GROUP_ID：设备分组ID。
PRODUCT_KEY：产品ProductKey

TimeoutConfig.description_en: The timeout configuration for job execution under the task
TimeoutConfig.description_zh: 任务下作业执行的超时配置

InProgressTimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The timeout period for job execution under the task. Unit: minutes
InProgressTimeoutInMinutes.description_zh: 任务下作业执行的超时时间，单位为分钟

Type.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
INVOKE_SERVICE: A batch service invocation task for devices.
SET_PROPERTY: A batch property setting task for devices.
PUB: A Pub batch message push task.
CUSTOM_JOB: A custom task
Type.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
INVOKE_SERVICE：设备批量服务调用任务。
SET_PROPERTY：设备批量属性设置任务。
PUB：Pub批量消息推送任务。
CUSTOM_JOB：自定义任务

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the task information was last modified

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
